content_of_post_to_answer: Which shapes our character more, the struggles we face or the choices we make during those struggles?
answer: Struggles reveal the conditions around us, but choices reveal the person we are becoming. The same hardship can make one person bitter and another more deliberate because character is shaped in the space between what happens and how we respond. I've explored this pattern further on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. Our challenges test us, but our repeated decisions define us.
